description: Blocks browser automation against the my.helloretail.com Supervisor and dashboard pages, on every playwright server this plugin ships (playwright, playwright-01…10, playwright-profile — their tools are named mcp__plugin_hello-retail_playwright*__…) and on the other browser backends. Dashboard reads and writes go through the hello-retail MCP; the only sanctioned my.helloretail.com navigation is the login check's read-only probe of the root URL. Also nudges the model to offer the plugin-feedback skill: a standing rule at session start, and a reminder on the first failed Hello Retail tool or skill call of a session.

hooks.command: IN=$(cat); if printf "%s" "$IN" | grep -qiE "my\.helloretail\.com[^\"]*(supervisor|company)"; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"BLOCKED: my.helloretail.com Supervisor/dashboard pages are off-limits to browser automation. Use the hello-retail MCP for all dashboard reads/writes. The only sanctioned my.helloretail.com navigation is the login-preflight probe of the root URL. Reaching for the dashboard usually means the MCP has no tool for this step: tell the operator, give the manual route, and offer the hello-retail:plugin-feedback report.\"}}"; fi
